{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Abo b'Yentarr''''' was the name that the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]] gave to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They believed it to be a manifestation of the power of the ''[[Yentarr]]'', [[Deity/Legends|deity]]-like entities they believed in meaning the unknown spirits, with abo b'Yentarr meaning power of the unknown spirits. Those Bosph who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] were known as [[ela b'Yentarr]], meaning the chosen of the unknown spirits.<ref name="AE">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}} {{1stID|ela b'Yentarr}}</ref>
